text:
QUOTE: "Two mechanisms, both gated on `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`" ... "So the runtime setter appears to exist only when `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY` is defined and the macro overrides are not."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair (`MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO`/`FREE_MACRO`) from the runtime function-pointer pair (`mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`). It also says the setter exists only when the macro overrides are not defined, which is mutual exclusivity, although it hedges that this is inferred.
